name: BDRShield
description_en:
BDRShield is Vembu’s backup and disaster-recovery product, presented on its current homepage as the successor name to BDRSuite. It offers cloud or on-premises management and local/cloud storage choices for virtual machines, physical systems, SaaS and application workloads.

The relevant question is which protection and restore path applies to your source, not whether the family lists many platforms. This profile uses VMware backup as a concrete example and separates workload licensing from optional storage. Documentation was read; software was not installed.
description_zh:
BDRShield 是 Vembu 的备份和灾难恢复产品，当前首页说明 BDRSuite 已改称 BDRShield。它提供云端或本地管理，以及本地／云存储选项，覆盖虚拟机、物理系统、SaaS 和应用工作负载。

选型重点是来源适用哪种保护和恢复路径，不能只看家族的平台数量。本文以 VMware 备份为例，并区分工作负载许可与可选存储；已阅读文档，未安装软件。

core_features.explanation_zh: 选择本地、厂商云或支持的客户云存储。

sections.title_en: Design one VM recovery before expanding
sections.title_zh: 先设计一台 VM 的恢复
sections.en:
The VMware page describes agentless image backup, changed-block tracking, scheduled jobs, whole-VM and file recovery, plus replication. Its setup sequence is to install the Backup Server, add ESXi or vCenter, choose policies and storage, then configure recovery. Agentless backup still requires suitable source access and compatible infrastructure.

For an example application VM, restore to a spare target with deliberate network mapping so the test does not collide with the live instance. Check application startup and an actual data read. Automated verification that boots a VM and emails a screenshot is useful, but does not prove application-level correctness.
sections.zh:
VMware 页面说明无代理镜像备份、变化块跟踪、调度、整台 VM 或文件恢复及复制。接入顺序为安装 Backup Server、添加 ESXi 或 vCenter、选择策略与存储，再配置恢复。无代理仍要求适当来源权限和兼容基础设施。

例如，把应用 VM 恢复到备用目标，并明确网络映射，避免测试与线上实例冲突。还应检查应用启动和真实数据读取。自动验证启动 VM 并邮件发送截图有参考价值，但不能证明应用逻辑正确。

sections.title_en: Management location and backup destination are separate
sections.title_zh: 管理位置与备份目标是两件事
sections.en:
A cloud console does not mean every backup must live in the vendor cloud. Official storage pages describe local storage and customer cloud repositories including S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud and S3-compatible providers. The on-premises console is also offered.

Decide the repository, copy topology, retention and credentials independently of the management UI. For ransomware recovery, verify the actual destination’s immutability configuration and the account’s ability to change retention; the product’s “ransomware-proof” marketing is not an independently demonstrated guarantee. Customer storage and transfer costs remain part of the design.
sections.zh:
使用云控制台不代表所有备份必须存放在厂商云。官方存储页说明本地存储及客户云仓库，包括 S3、Azure Blob、Google Cloud 和 S3 兼容服务，也提供本地控制台。

仓库、复制拓扑、保留及凭据应独立于管理界面决定。为勒索软件恢复选型时，应核对真实目标的不可变配置和账户修改保留期的权限，不能把“ransomware-proof”宣传当作独立验证的保证。客户存储和传输费仍属于方案成本。

sections.title_en: License the source and price storage separately
sections.title_zh: 来源许可与存储分别计价
sections.en:
The current pricing page routes buyers to a quote and defines different units: endpoints, servers, users for SaaS, VMs, applications and 500-GB NAS/file-share blocks. Optional vendor cloud is charged per GB. The page advertises Amazon S3-backed storage from USD 0.03 per GB-month and labels its Wasabi option coming soon; it does not provide a complete workload quote.

For example, ten endpoints and twenty protected Microsoft 365 users need ten endpoint and twenty user entitlements, plus any applicable storage. Do not add those as thirty interchangeable licenses with one assumed rate. The advertised full-featured trial lasts 30 days; exact free-license allowances were not read.
sections.zh:
当前定价页引导询价，并按端点、服务器、SaaS 用户、VM、应用及每 500 GB NAS／共享文件块等单位授权；可选厂商云按 GB 收费。页面列 Amazon S3 支撑存储起价每 GB 月 0.03 美元，Wasabi 选项为即将推出，但未给完整工作负载报价。

例如，十个端点和二十个受保护 Microsoft 365 用户，需要十份端点和二十份用户权益，再加适用存储费，不能简单算成三十份相同单价的许可。宣传的完整功能试用为 30 天，本次未实读免费许可的具体额度。

sections.title_en: Perpetual use differs from ongoing maintenance
sections.title_zh: 永久使用与持续维护不同
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ describes annual and multiyear subscriptions and perpetual licensing. Perpetual purchases include one year of maintenance; further support and updates require the applicable maintenance arrangement. A free Backup Server installation is not a free license for every protected workload.

Shortlist BDRShield for an IT team or MSP able to maintain repositories, source permissions and recovery tests across mixed workloads. Before purchase, obtain exact version support, storage economics and failure-escalation details, and perform a representative restore. Recovery speed, malware detection effectiveness and service-provider margins were not measured.
sections.zh:
定价 FAQ 说明年付、多年订阅及永久许可。永久购买附一年维护，后续支持及更新需要适用维护安排。Backup Server 安装免费不代表每个受保护工作负载都免费。

能够为混合工作负载维护仓库、来源权限和恢复测试的 IT 团队或 MSP，可考虑 BDRShield。购买前需取得准确版本支持、存储成本及故障升级说明，并恢复代表性样例。本文未测量恢复速度、恶意软件检测效果或服务商利润。

research_gaps.en: Exact free-license allowances, legal EULA, source-version compatibility and complete workload quote were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未确认免费许可额度、法律 EULA、来源版本兼容性及完整工作负载报价。

research_gaps.en: No install, application restore, malware test or recovery benchmark was executed; storage immutability depends on real configuration.
research_gaps.zh: 未安装、恢复应用、测试恶意软件或恢复性能；存储不可变性取决于真实配置。
